answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the nectar of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The nebula lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the yarrow is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, slashed on a failed audit, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
